summary: Review outbound or lifecycle sales email for relevance, burden, proof and ask proportionality.

must_inspect.why: The recipient should understand why the message is about them before being asked to spend attention or commit.
false_positive_guards: Personalization tokens alone are not evidence of relevance.

must_inspect.why: The proof burden rises with the size of the requested commitment.
false_positive_guards: A small reply CTA does not require the same proof as a purchase request.

must_inspect.why: Every paragraph competes with the requested action and should earn its place.
false_positive_guards: Do not equate brevity with quality when context is necessary to make the ask credible.
Do not invent the recipient persona.
